# loopway

> loopway is a notification system for your bots. It accepts webhooks from the services you use and keeps each delivery as a CloudEvent, for your own code to read.

If a person asks you to set up loopway, the steps are below. Everything is done with the `loopway` CLI, which talks to {{base_url}}.

## Concepts

- **Inbox**: holds one source's webhook secret and receives its deliveries. It is named by its `source_type`: `github`, `linear`, `vercel`, `granola`, `resend`, `schedule` (a message on a clock) or `loopway` (messages pushed with a token).
- **Message**: one stored delivery: the CloudEvent (its `type`, e.g. `com.github.issues.opened`, and `data`) and when it arrived. Nothing is marked done.

## Setup

```bash
curl -fsSL {{base_url}}/install.sh | sh
loopway login
loopway inbox create
loopway inbox show <inbox>      # the webhook URL to add in the sender
loopway messages list <inbox>
loopway messages get <inbox> <message> --data
```
